judgementCalls: The Illinois State Peace Officer certification (stated in the 1985-1997 police job and again under Education) is required once as a credential, with no status; the 'weapon certification' in the same bullet may come out as a second entry or not at all.

'Business Communications - Area of Study' and 'Counseling & Pastoral Care - Area of Study' name no degree: each is required as an education entry of unclear level (other / certificate / associate, not bachelor), completed or not.
The Education section's text is run together, so which school goes with which programme is unclear; schools are not checked.
The police training academy certification is allowed as an education entry (certificate or other) but not required.
The affiliations line names religious organisations, which state a religion; none of the forbidden terms may appear in the profile.
The CV mixes admissions, executive-assistant and 'Executive Administration and Operations Manager' framings, so a wide set of first target roles is accepted.
